info.name: TrueCollective Access Gateway
info.description: API contract tests (tasks.md T059 / T098, FR-029 / SC-010). Every response is asserted against packages/openapi/openapi.yaml: domain rejections carry an ErrorCode from error-codes.md, non-domain failures the {error} envelope. Positive flows that need wallet signatures (owner keygate, settle, licensee share) are covered by the Playwright specs; this collection covers their HTTP-shaped negative facets of the §10.1 matrix. Requires ASSET_ID / OWNER_WALLET in the environment (seeded by the assets request when the gateway lists assets).
